allow_anonymous.description: Allow anonymous FTP logins (not recommended for production).

puredb_path.description: Path to the PureDB password database file (used only when auth_backend = 'puredb').

require_tls.description: Enforce TLS/SSL for all connections (secure FTPS). Required for modern compliance.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Same file if combined cert+key.

chroot_all.description: Chroot every user to their home directory for security (recommended).

hide_ids.description: Hide user/group numeric IDs in directory listings (display names only).

max_clients.description: Maximum total number of simultaneous FTP clients.

max_clients_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections allowed per client IP address.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to (empty = all interfaces).

passive_port_range_start.description: Start of passive data port range (must match firewall/NAT rules).

passive_port_range_end.description: End of passive data port range.

public_ip.description: Public IP address advertised to clients (useful behind NAT; 'auto' detects automatically).

auto_homedir.description: Automatically create home directories for system users upon first login.

max_bandwidth.description: Maximum upload/download bandwidth per user in KB/s (0 = unlimited).

extra_config.description: Additional configuration lines to append (e.g., custom flags from /etc/pure-ftpd/conf.d/). Each item is one line.

items.description: A single raw configuration line (e.g., 'NoAnonymous', 'VerboseLog yes')
